title: REQ · Failed history load shows 'Could not load your suggestions' with a Retry button
summary: History failure renders the error message and Retry button
description: Context: ContributionSheet sets historyStatus to 'error' in the listMine catch. Desired behavior: in that state it renders the HISTORY_ERROR alert and a Retry button. Expected result: the player sees the explained failure and a way to retry. Why: failures must not be silent.
acceptance_criteria: Given listMine rejects, When the sheet is open, Then an element with role=alert has text 'Could not load your suggestions'
Given listMine rejects, When the sheet is open, Then a button named 'Retry' is present
Given listMine resolves, When the sheet is open, Then neither the error nor Retry is shown

in_scope: Error alert and Retry button rendering

technical_constraints: Message text must remain 'Could not load your suggestions'
definition_of_done: Error and Retry render only in error state
